description: This Java source file defines the class 'UpdateThingResponse', a command response related to acknowledging updates to a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It contains methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, getters for response details, and serialization logic.

classes.name: UpdateThingResponse
classes.description: A command response class indicating the result of updating a thing in the Ditto framework. It includes details such as the thing's ID, revision, success status, and optional policy information, along with JSON serialization and parsing capabilities.
